description:
SWITCH THE SOLUTION TO ITS NEXT MAJOR VERSION (X+1.0.0) — only when the user said yes.

The solution's version is X.Y.Z of what runs: every deploy adds one to Z, every promote makes it X.(Y+1).0, and X moves ONLY here. Never call it on your own. Ask first, in these words: "Current solution version is 1.9.57. Do you want to switch it to 2.0.0?" A deploy's `version_hint.major` tells you when to ask (ten promotes since the last major); the user may also ask for it any time.

Pass `to` = the number you showed them: a repeat then changes nothing, and a number the switch would not give is refused. Afterwards what runs is 2.0.0, the next deploy 2.0.1 and the next promote 2.1.0; cluster members follow. Nothing is redeployed. The same switch is a button in Tenant Admin › Promoted Versions.

to.description: The next major you offered the user, like "2.0.0" (the current X plus one, .0.0).

name: ateam_switch_major_version
